scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is restricted to cyclically marked strictly convex equal-area heptagons. It uses the published hyperbola-completion lemma/proposition of Craizer--Teixeira--da Silva and a new explicit specialization to \(n=7\). No finite experiment is used as proof. Literature searches did not locate the same specialization, but an unindexed elementary note remains a residual originality risk.
title: Contractible affine moduli of convex equal-area heptagons
